name: copy-hybrid

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec dspark --prefix-cache on --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: drafted == serial, six kinds and c=4, copy hybrid on and off
drafting follows the traffic (chat,code,reasoning,json,chat), copy hybrid on and off
each rolling reply equal to its solo reply, 3 runs x 2 configurations

notes: decode_mean4_tok_s is the median of the three run means of bench decode (85.4, 85.7, 85.4) with the copy hybrid at the engine default; the same binary with REXL3_INKLING2_LOOP_SPEC_COPY=off gave 83.92 (83.9, 83.8, 85.0) the same afternoon. The 100 tok/s target is not reached. Earlier policy (min match 8): raw/on-v1-min8, 85.91 but code -2.7 %: not shipped. Exactness: 2026-11-23-copy-hybrid-exact, same engine commit.
